hints.title: Evaluate Energy Buffer
hints.text: Each task requires a buffer of minimum minus actual energy that is preserved after completion.

hints.title: Sort by Buffer Margin
hints.text: Sort tasks in descending order of (minimum - actual) energy difference.

hints.title: Simulate or Accumulate
hints.text: Simulate with current energy, augmenting initial energy whenever current energy falls below minimum.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all n factorial task execution orders is infeasible.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting by energy margin takes O(n log n) time with O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should prove the exchange argument: tasks with largest (minimum - actual) should execute first.

solutions.approach: Greedy ordering by descending minimum minus actual energy difference
